description: This Scala source file defines classes and traits related to setting diagnostics information for Spark running on Kubernetes, including a provider for Kubernetes clients and a setter that annotates Kubernetes pods with exception details.

classes.name: KubernetesClientProvider
classes.description: A trait providing a method to create KubernetesClient instances, allowing for mocking in tests.

classes.name: DefaultKubernetesClientProvider
classes.description: Default implementation of KubernetesClientProvider that creates a KubernetesClient using SparkKubernetesClientFactory.

classes.name: SparkKubernetesDiagnosticsSetter
classes.description: Class responsible for setting diagnostics annotations on Kubernetes pods when exceptions occur, supporting Kubernetes-based Spark deployments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a KubernetesClient instance based on SparkConf configuration.

methods.name: setDiagnostics
methods.description: Sets diagnostics information as an annotation on the Kubernetes pod corresponding to the Spark driver, when an exception occurs.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given cluster manager URL corresponds to a Kubernetes cluster.
